heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1P requires upgrading the stock stainless steel nozzle and extruder gears to hardened steel before running abrasive ColorFabb XT-CF20. Once upgraded, it reliably prints this stiff PETG-CF composite at speeds up to 143 mm/s capped by a conservative 12 mm³/s volumetric flow limit.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with PVP glue stick or liquid release agent
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 12 mm³/s in the Filament Settings to prevent under-extrusion and hotend heat creep.
Enable Wipe While Retracting (2 mm distance) and set Retraction Length to 0.8 mm at 35 mm/s to minimize carbon fiber whisker stringing.
Reduce Part Cooling Fan to 20% min / 50% max and set 'Keep fan always on' to preserve inter-layer adhesion with PETG copolymer chemistry.
Set First Layer Speed to 35 mm/s with First Layer Bed Temp at 75°C and Hotend at 255°C for optimal mechanical bonding.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Rapid nozzle wear and erratic line width
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: The 20% carbon fiber loading rapidly erodes the P1P's factory-installed 300-series stainless steel nozzle orifice.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Install an official Bambu Lab 0.4mm or 0.6mm Hardened Steel Hotend assembly along with hardened extruder drive gears.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Severe stringing, oozing, and brittle layer bonds
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: ColorFabb XT-CF20 is hygroscopic; ambient moisture absorption causes hydrolysis and steam expansion during extrusion.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the spool in a dedicated active filament dryer at 65-70°C for at least 8 to 12 hours before printing.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Permanent adhesion damage / PEI coating tearing off
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: ColorFabb XT (amorphous copolyester) bonds aggressively to clean PEI surfaces without a separation barrier.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply a uniform thin layer of Bambu Liquid Glue or standard glue stick to act strictly as a sacrificial release interface.

faq.question: Can I print ColorFabb XT-CF20 with the stock Bambu Lab P1P nozzle?
faq.answer: No. The stock stainless steel nozzle will degrade within 200-500g of printing 20% carbon fiber filament. You must upgrade to the Bambu Lab hardened steel hotend and hardened extruder gear kit.

faq.question: Does the P1P require an enclosure to print XT-CF20?
faq.answer: No, an enclosure is not strictly required. XT-CF20 has lower shrinkage and warping tendencies than standard ABS or PA, allowing reliable open-frame printing on a 75°C bed provided drafts are minimized.

faq.question: Can I use a 0.4mm hardened nozzle or is 0.6mm necessary?
faq.answer: A 0.4mm hardened nozzle works cleanly with ColorFabb XT-CF20 due to its micro-milled carbon fibers, but a 0.6mm nozzle virtually eliminates clog risk and permits higher volumetric flow rates.

faq.question: Can I run ColorFabb XT-CF20 through the Bambu Lab AMS?
faq.answer: It is not recommended. The rigid carbon fibers in XT-CF20 can rapidly score AMS internal PTFE tubes, funnels, and feeder gears, leading to abrasive grooving and filament feed failures.
